F-AC5-DIGEST-NOT-ENFORCED: Enforced feature_contract_digest across artifacts: (a) splitter.py persists digest in manifest and rejects cache hit on missing or mismatch digest; (b) run_pipeline.py rebuilds MTF archives on digest mismatch; (c) mtf/archives.py persists digest in archive identity and validates during payload loading; (d) phases/phase2_rule_pool.py persists digest in save_archive and validates in _validate_archive_payload; (e) phases/phase5_oos.py validates digest during standalone strategy loading, rejecting stale RB outputs. Added tests for stale split, MTF archive, Phase 2 archive, and RB output rejections.
